# dim_advisor_events

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.dim_advisor_events` · dbt area: `advisor_events`

Dimension table for advisor events such as FAM trips, Days of Learning, and chapter events. Each row is a unique event including information such as location, type, venue, tags, and a flag for whether it was hosted by Fora HQ. Sourced from Splash data (via Google Sheets).

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `advisor_event_id` | The unique event ID. SOURCE >> Splash |
| `city` | The city of the Event as listed in Splash. SOURCE >> Splash via Google Sheets |
| `country` | The country of the Event as listed in Splash. SOURCE >> Splash via Google Sheets |
| `event_name` | The name of the event. SOURCE >> Splash |
| `event_start_date` | Date when the event began. SOURCE >> Splash via Google Sheets |
| `event_tags` | A list of all event tags (such as 'partner fam', 'fora fam', 'mexico'). SOURCE >> Splash |
| `event_type` | The type of event (such as Fam Trip, Live Forum, Chapter Event, Day of Learning). SOURCE >> Splash via Google Sheets |
| `event_venue` | The name of the venue where the event took place, such as a hotel name. SOURCE >> Splash via Google Sheets |
| `is_hosted_by_fora` | True/False flag of whether the event was hosted by Fora HQ. SOURCE >> Splash via Google Sheets |
| `state_province` | The state/province where the event took place. SOURCE >> Splash via Google Sheets |
